title: retentionfrac: the identity-retention fraction for paired tumor-adjacent expression contrasts

creators.name: Nam, Soon Woo
creators.affiliation: Incheon St. Mary's Hospital, College of Medicine, The Catholic University of Korea

description: Analysis code, gene sets, result files and the locked protocol for the study How much of a tumor expression signature is dedifferentiation? A pre-registered measure in three tissues and its failure to transfer between transcriptome and proteome. Includes retentionfrac, a one-function Python package that computes the identity-retention fraction with a bootstrap interval and refuses to return a value when the identity premise or the ratio-stability guard fails.
